text:
anna: FYI: nightly regression on H100 dedicated pools for seqlen 256-384. p95 up ~18% vs last week. digging in now.
matt: ugh, saw that too in prod traces. looks like more regspills reported in profiler output. any recent kernel picks changed?
jh: I ran a quick microbench across kernels A/B/C (old/new/kernel-picker-2025). metrics: 
```
seqlen=256 throughput tok/s: A=38k B=33k C=30k
regspill counts: A=12 B=47 C=92
smem usage %: A=62 B=81 C=94
occupancy %: A=72 B=54 C=40
```
A is the previous pick, B is the new default on H100, C is the fallback path.
oliver: that looks like B increased register pressure and spilled into local memory for mid lengths. probably due to new bank-mapping heuristic that favored larger tiles.
dani: I think the KV prefetch changes (PR#4123) bumped live regs by 6 in the hot loop. Combined with larger tile sizes it's enough to push some warps over the bank limit.
anna: can we do a quick mitigation: seqlen-gated kernel selection? small (<128) use new tiled path, medium (128-512) stick to old bank-mapping, long (>512) use long-seq prefetched path. simple rule in kernel-picker until we autotune.
matt: sounds reasonable. we should verify cost tradeoff: small seqs benefit from throughput optimizations; medium seqs prefer lower reg pressure.
jh: ran a patch locally that gates based on seq bucket + arch. results: p95 median improvement on H100 for 256 was -14% latency and regspills dropped from 47->14. will push numbers to the perf dashboard.
ci-bot: build #8274 (branch=seqlen-gate-hotfix) succeeded. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/8274
oliver: nice. two followups: 1) add an explicit tile-bank mapping unit test for mid seqs so future autotunes don't regress, 2) add perf counter to catch regspill rate >20% relative delta in nightly.
dani: agreed. i'll add the unit test and a lightweight kernel-level microbench to perf-suite.
steph: what's the rollout plan? canary on Dedicated H100 pool and then to hosted?
sre-bot: canary schedule requested: deploy to dedicated-h100-canary at 05:00 UTC tomorrow, 2-hour observation window, auto-rollback on error rate >1% or latency p95 > +10% vs baseline.
matt: let's also record KV cache hitrates in the canary; medium seqs saw more KV churn in earlier runs which amplifies latency.
anna: assigned: matt = canary monitoring dashboard tiles, dani = tests & microbench, jh = open PR and add gating flag, oliver = add perf-alert rule. i'll shepherd rollout.
matt: cool. after canary, if stable we'll keep gating for 2 weeks while iterating autotuner to pick bank mapping per (arch, seqlen-dist). :thumbsup:
anna: thanks all. I'll post a short summary in #eng-runtime after deploy.
